Consuelo OS ships with a curated set of skills. A skill is reusable operating guidance: it tells an agent when a workflow applies, which OS tools to combine, what boundaries to preserve, and how to verify the result.

## Available skills

| Skill | Name | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Artifacts](/build/skills/bundled/artifacts/) | `artifacts` | Canonical orchestration skill for creating, validating, publishing, finding, and revising durable Consuelo artifacts such as sites, guides, specifications, plans, reports, demos, emails, images, and motion outputs. |
| [Branch Planner](/build/skills/bundled/branch/) | `branch` | Align on large engineering projects, investigate hidden risks, and decompose them into dependency-aware branch and PR stacks that can be executed across focused chats or agents. |
| [Browser](/build/skills/bundled/browser/) | `browser` | use for known-url browser work, rendered-page extraction, authenticated pages, live UI verification, Interact with docs and JS-heavy pages, screenshots, accessibility snapshots, and browser evidence. use when provided a URL to inspect, test or verify a webpage or UI, needs scraping/fetching from, wants screenshots or truth, or pages that require clicking, filling, login state, tabs, accordions, or auth. use built-in web search for discovery first, and use browser known-url, use togther. |
| [Debugger](/build/skills/bundled/debugger/) | `debugger` | Use this OS skill for runtime debugging across browser behavior, deployment logs, error tracking, analytics, and code evidence. Invoke it for bug triage, incidents, post-merge validation, frontend regressions, worker or queue issues, telephony flows, observability checks, and reconciling runtime truth with code assumptions. |
| [Handoff](/build/skills/bundled/handoff/) | `handoff` | Use this skill when the user asks to create, read, update, search, summarize, or continue from handoff/context records so another agent or future session can pick up the work safely. |
| [Research Ingest](/build/skills/bundled/research-ingest/) | `research-ingest` | use this skill when ko sends a youtube, podcast, article, paper, pdf, media link, or local source and wants to learn from it, discuss it, turn it into notes, compare it with other sources, or save it as durable research. this skill governs the research ingest workflow: run the workspace research ingest tool, create packet/extracted/manifest artifacts, automatically save their full text to memory, then reason from the saved bundle. use for research packets, source ingestion, podcast/video learning, durable memory, and follow-up analysis from ingested sources.. |
| [Senior Engineer](/build/skills/bundled/senior-engineer/) | `senior-engineer` | Use this skill for any coding, debugging, refactoring, architecture, validation, or task in the repository. This skill is the default engineering mode. Invoke it whenever the assistant is expected to read code, change code, diagnose a bug, design an implementation plan, review a diff, run tests, validate behavior, or prepare a PR. |
| [Sites](/build/skills/bundled/sites/) | `sites` | Use this skill for Consuelo OS site delivery infrastructure: launcher pages, typed pages, traces, diffs, settings, and the static delivery layer used by Consuelo Artifacts. |
| [Skill Creator](/build/skills/bundled/skill-creator/) | `skill-creator` | Use this OS operator skill when creating, migrating, editing, validating, or reviewing opensaas/Consuelo OS skills. It turns skill workflows into repo-backed skill folders, skill.json metadata, migration fixtures, replacement allowlists, registry generation, install seeding, and tests, with exact-copy guardrails unless Ko explicitly approves a rewrite. |
| [Task Workflow](/build/skills/bundled/task/) | `task` | Use this skill for any opensaas task lifecycle work: starting a task, researching, editing, publishing, creating the stream review PR, handling task metadata conflicts, or cleaning up. It enforces stream.context → task.start → task.push → task.pr → task.finish, explicit branch usage, verified tool results, metadata-only conflict rules, and reporting the `stream/<area>` → main review PR instead of the intermediate task PR. |
| [Teach](/build/skills/bundled/teach/) | `teach` | Use this skill when the user asks the OS agent to teach them a daily deep idea, create an AI-seeded learning guide, ingest a research source for teaching, or publish a durable Sites guide that explains one transferable concept. It coordinates research ingest, typed guide rendering, Sites publishing, and optional teach state updates. |

## Enable or remove a bundled skill

Use the interactive picker:

```bash
consuelo add skill
consuelo remove skill
```

Or manage skills directly by name:

```bash
consuelo add skill branch browser
consuelo remove skill teach
```

The selected set is stored in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/config.json`. Consuelo reconciles that selection into the active managed index at `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json` and materializes selected skills under `~/Consuelo/Skills/`.

See [Install a skill](/build/skills/install-a-skill/) for the full selection and preservation behavior.
